title: CISA Adds Seven Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
summary: CISA has added seven new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog , based on evidence of active exploitation. CVE(s) Microsoft Windows Buffer Overflow Vulnerability CVE(s) Microsoft DirectX NULL Byte Overwrite Vulnerability CVE(s) Adobe Acrobat and Reader Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability CVE(s) Microsoft Internet Explorer Use-After-Free Vulnerability CVE(s) Microsoft Internet Explorer Use-After-Free Vulnerability CVE(s) Microsoft Defender Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability CVE(s) Microsoft Defender Denial of Service Vulnerability These types of vulnerabilities are frequent attack vectors for malicious cyber actors and pose significant risks to the federal enterprise.
